category_edits.rationale: Increase tied item embedding width from 48 to 64 across all four category models. Existing hidden_units plumbing resizes the matching convolution channels, saves the width in metadata, and reconstructs matching predictor shapes. Preserve features, topology, scoring, loss, optimizer and one checkpoint per category.

change_summary: Increase tied embedding and matching hidden width to 64; existing metadata-backed predictor construction maintains checkpoint compatibility.
